Charts

Pure CSS and SVG chart components — bar, line, pie/donut, and area charts rendered without any charting library. Includes legends, grid lines, and mock tooltips.

HTML
<div class="bar-chart" style="display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; height: 200px;">
  <div class="bar" style="height: 65%; background: var(--zak-primary); position: relative;">
    <span style="position: absolute; top: -1.25rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 0.6875rem;">$650</span>
    <div style="text-align: center; font-size: 0.6875rem; padding-top: 0.25rem;">Mon</div>
  </div>
  <div class="bar" style="height: 85%; background: var(--zak-primary);">...</div>
</div>

Pie Chart

Pure CSS pie chart using conic-gradient.

Desktop 35%
Mobile 25%
Tablet 20%
Other 20%
CSS
.pie-chart {
  width: 200px;
  height: 200px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: conic-gradient(
    var(--zak-primary) 0deg 126deg,
    var(--zak-success) 126deg 216deg,
    var(--zak-warning) 216deg 288deg,
    var(--zak-danger) 288deg 360deg
  );
}
